verses.original: מַשָּׂ֤א דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַדְרָ֔ךְ וְדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק מְנֻחָת֑וֹ כִּ֤י לַֽיהוָה֙ עֵ֣ין אָדָ֔ם וְכֹ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh bə·’e·reṣ ḥaḏ·rāḵ wə·ḏam·me·śeq mə·nu·ḥā·ṯōw kî Yah·weh ‘ên ’ā·ḏām wə·ḵōl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: This is the burden of the word of the LORD against the land of Hadrach and Damascus its resting place for the eyes of men and of all the tribes of Israel are upon the LORD
verses.literalPt: Oráculo da palavra de Jeová contra a terra de Hadraque, e Damasco será o seu lugar de descanso; pois os olhos do homem e de todas as tribos de Israel estão voltados para Jeová;

verses.original: וְגַם־ חֲמָ֖ת תִּגְבָּל־ בָּ֑הּ צֹ֣ר וְצִיד֔וֹן כִּ֥י חָֽכְמָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ḥă·māṯ tiḡ·bāl- bāh ṣōr wə·ṣî·ḏō·wn kî ḥāḵ·māh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: and also against Hamath which borders it as well as Tyre and Sidon though they are very shrewd
verses.literalPt: também Hamate, que confina com ela, Tiro juntamente com Sidom, porque é muito sábio.

verses.original: וַתִּ֥בֶן צֹ֛ר מָצ֖וֹר לָ֑הּ וַתִּצְבָּר־ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ כֶּֽעָפָ֔ר וְחָר֖וּץ כְּטִ֥יט חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ti·ḇen ṣōr mā·ṣō·wr lāh wat·tiṣ·bār- ke·sep̄ ke·‘ā·p̄ār wə·ḥā·rūṣ kə·ṭîṭ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: Tyre has built herself a fortress she has heaped up silver like dust and gold like the dirt of the streets
verses.literalPt: Tiro edificou para si um lugar forte, e amontoou prata como o pó e ouro fino como a lama das ruas.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אֲדֹנָי֙ יֽוֹרִשֶׁ֔נָּה וְהִכָּ֥ה בַיָּ֖ם חֵילָ֑הּ וְהִ֖יא בָּאֵ֥שׁ תֵּאָכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nāy yō·w·ri·šen·nāh wə·hik·kāh ḇay·yām ḥê·lāh wə·hî bā·’êš tê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: Behold the Lord will impoverish her and cast her wealth into the sea and she will be consumed by fire
verses.literalPt: Eis que o Senhor a desapossará e ferirá o seu poder no mar, e ela será devorada pelo fogo.

verses.original: תֵּרֶ֨א אַשְׁקְל֜וֹן וְתִירָ֗א וְעַזָּה֙ וְתָחִ֣יל מְאֹ֔ד וְעֶקְר֖וֹן כִּֽי־ הֹבִ֣ישׁ מֶבָּטָ֑הּ וְאָ֤בַד מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ מֵֽעַזָּ֔ה וְאַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לֹ֥א תֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: tê·re ’aš·qə·lō·wn wə·ṯî·rā wə·‘az·zāh wə·ṯā·ḥîl mə·’ōḏ wə·‘eq·rō·wn kî- hō·ḇîš meb·bā·ṭāh wə·’ā·ḇaḏ me·leḵ mê·‘az·zāh wə·’aš·qə·lō·wn lō ṯê·šêḇ
verses.literal: Ashkelon will see and fear Gaza will writhe in agony . . . as will Ekron for her hope will wither There will cease to be a king in Gaza and Ashkelon will be uninhabited . . .
verses.literalPt: Asquelom o verá e terá medo; também Gaza e ficará passada de dor; e Ecrom, porque a sua esperança será envergonhada; de Gaza perecerá o rei, e Asquelom não será habitada.

verses.original: וְיָשַׁ֥ב מַמְזֵ֖ר בְּאַשְׁדּ֑וֹד וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י גְּא֥וֹן פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šaḇ mam·zêr bə·’aš·dō·wḏ wə·hiḵ·rat·tî gə·’ō·wn pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: A mixed race will occupy Ashdod and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines
verses.literalPt: Um bastardo habitará em Asdode, e exterminarei a soberba dos filisteus.

verses.original: וַהֲסִרֹתִ֨י דָמָ֜יו מִפִּ֗יו וְשִׁקֻּצָיו֙ מִבֵּ֣ין שִׁנָּ֔יו וְנִשְׁאַ֥ר גַּם־ ה֖וּא לֵֽאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְהָיָה֙ כְּאַלֻּ֣ף בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְעֶקְר֖וֹן כִּיבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·si·rō·ṯî ḏā·māw mip·pîw wə·šiq·qu·ṣāw mib·bên šin·nāw wə·niš·’ar gam- hū lê·lō·hê·nū wə·hā·yāh kə·’al·lup̄ bî·hū·ḏāh wə·‘eq·rō·wn kî·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: I will remove the blood from their mouths and the abominations from between their teeth Then they too will become a remnant for our God they will become like a clan in Judah and Ekron will be like the Jebusites
verses.literalPt: Tirarei da sua boca o seu sangue e, dentre os seus dentes, as suas abominações; ficará também ele de resto para o nosso Deus; e será como chefe em Judá, e Ecrom, como jebuseu.

verses.original: וְחָנִ֨יתִי לְבֵיתִ֤י מִצָּבָה֙ מֵעֹבֵ֣ר וּמִשָּׁ֔ב וְלֹֽא־ יַעֲבֹ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם ע֖וֹד נֹגֵ֑שׂ כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְעֵינָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·nî·ṯî lə·ḇê·ṯî miṣ·ṣā·ḇāh mê·‘ō·ḇêr ū·miš·šāḇ wə·lō- ya·‘ă·ḇōr ‘ă·lê·hem ‘ō·wḏ nō·ḡêś kî ‘at·tāh rā·’î·ṯî ḇə·‘ê·nāy
verses.literal: But I will camp around My house because of an army because of those who march to and fro . . . and never again . . . will an oppressor overrun My people for now I keep watch with My own eyes
verses.literalPt: Ao redor da minha casa, acamparei contra o exército, para que ninguém passe, nem volte; e não passará mais por eles o exator, pois, agora, o tenho visto com os meus olhos.

verses.original: גִּילִ֨י מְאֹ֜ד בַּת־ צִיּ֗וֹן הָרִ֙יעִי֙ בַּ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הִנֵּ֤ה מַלְכֵּךְ֙ יָ֣בוֹא לָ֔ךְ צַדִּ֥יק וְנוֹשָׁ֖ע ה֑וּא עָנִי֙ וְרֹכֵ֣ב עַל־ חֲמ֔וֹר וְעַל־ עַ֖יִר בֶּן־ אֲתֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: gî·lî mə·’ōḏ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn hā·rî·‘î baṯ yə·rū·šā·lim hin·nêh mal·kêḵ yā·ḇō·w lāḵ ṣad·dîq wə·nō·wō·šā‘ hū ‘ā·nî wə·rō·ḵêḇ ‘al- ḥă·mō·wr wə·‘al- ‘a·yir ben- ’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Rejoice greatly O Daughter of Zion Shout in triumph O Daughter of Jerusalem See your King comes to you righteous and victorious humble and riding on a donkey on a colt the foal of a donkey
verses.literalPt: Regozija-te muito, filha de Sião; exulta, filha de Jerusalém; eis que vem a ti o teu Rei. Ele é justo, e trás a salvação; ele é pobre e vem montado sobre um jumento, sobre um potrinho, filho de uma jumenta.

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּי־ רֶ֣כֶב מֵאֶפְרַ֗יִם וְסוּס֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְנִכְרְתָה֙ קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֔ה וְדִבֶּ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם לַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּמָשְׁלוֹ֙ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־ יָ֔ם וּמִנָּהָ֖ר עַד־ אַפְסֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·rat·tî- re·ḵeḇ mê·’ep̄·ra·yim wə·sūs mî·rū·šā·lim wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh qe·šeṯ mil·ḥā·māh wə·ḏib·ber šā·lō·wm lag·gō·w·yim ū·mā·šə·lōw mî·yām ‘aḏ- yām ū·min·nā·hār ‘aḏ- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem and the bow of war will be broken Then He will proclaim peace to the nations His dominion will extend from sea to sea and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth
verses.literalPt: De Efraim exterminarei os carros, e de Jerusalém, os cavalos, e o arco de guerra será exterminado. Ele anunciará a paz às nações; o seu domínio se estenderá de mar a mar e desde o rio até as extremidades da terra.

verses.original: גַּם־ אַ֣תְּ בְּדַם־ בְּרִיתֵ֗ךְ שִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי אֲסִירַ֙יִךְ֙ מִבּ֔וֹר אֵ֥ין מַ֖יִם בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’at bə·ḏam- bə·rî·ṯêḵ šil·laḥ·tî ʾă·sī·ra·yiḵ mib·bō·wr ’ên ma·yim bōw
verses.literal: As for you because of the blood of My covenant I will release your prisoners from the waterless . . . pit
verses.literalPt: Quanto a ti, por causa do sangue da tua aliança, tenho feito aos teus presos sair da cova em que não há água.

verses.original: שׁ֚וּבוּ לְבִצָּר֔וֹן אֲסִירֵ֖י הַתִּקְוָ֑ה גַּם־ הַיּ֕וֹם מַגִּ֥יד מִשְׁנֶ֖ה אָשִׁ֥יב לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šû·b̲û lə·ḇiṣ·ṣā·rō·wn ’ă·sî·rê hat·tiq·wāh gam- hay·yō·wm mag·gîḏ miš·neh ’ā·šîḇ lāḵ
verses.literal: Return to your stronghold O prisoners of hope even today I declare that I will restore to you double
verses.literalPt: Voltai para o lugar forte, ó presos da esperança; também hoje anuncio que te pagarei em dobro.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ דָרַ֨כְתִּי לִ֜י יְהוּדָ֗ה קֶ֚שֶׁת מִלֵּ֣אתִי אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְעוֹרַרְתִּ֤י בָנַ֙יִךְ֙ צִיּ֔וֹן עַל־ בָּנַ֖יִךְ יָוָ֑ן וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךְ כְּחֶ֥רֶב גִּבּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḏā·raḵ·tî lî yə·hū·ḏāh qe·šeṯ mil·lê·ṯî ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·‘ō·w·rar·tî ḇā·na·yiḵ ṣî·yō·wn ‘al- bā·na·yiḵ yā·wān wə·śam·tîḵ kə·ḥe·reḇ gib·bō·wr
verses.literal: For I will bend Judah as My bow and fit it with Ephraim I will rouse your sons O Zion against the sons of Greece I will make you like the sword of a mighty man
verses.literalPt: Pois para mim tenho estendido a Judá, tenho enchido de Efraim o arco; incitarei teus filhos, ó Sião, contra teus filhos, ó Grécia, e te farei a ti como a espada de um valente.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָה֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יֵֽרָאֶ֔ה וְיָצָ֥א כַבָּרָ֖ק חִצּ֑וֹ וַֽאדֹנָ֤י יְהֹוִה֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֣ר יִתְקָ֔ע וְהָלַ֖ךְ בְּסַעֲר֥וֹת תֵּימָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·hem yê·rā·’eh wə·yā·ṣā ḵab·bā·rāq ḥiṣ·ṣōw wa·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh baš·šō·w·p̄ār yiṯ·qā‘ wə·hā·laḵ bə·sa·‘ă·rō·wṯ tê·mān
verses.literal: Then the LORD will appear over them and His arrow will go forth like lightning The Lord GOD will sound the ram’s horn and advance in the whirlwinds of the south
verses.literalPt: Por cima deles será visto Jeová, e as suas flechas sairão como o relâmpago; o Senhor Jeová tocará a trombeta e irá com redemoinho do Sul.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֮ יָגֵ֣ן עֲלֵיהֶם֒ וְאָכְל֗וּ וְכָֽבְשׁוּ֙ אַבְנֵי־ קֶ֔לַע וְשָׁת֥וּ הָמ֖וּ כְּמוֹ־ יָ֑יִן וּמָֽלְאוּ֙ כַּמִּזְרָ֔ק כְּזָוִיּ֖וֹת מִזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yā·ḡên ‘ă·lê·hem wə·’ā·ḵə·lū wə·ḵā·ḇə·šū ’aḇ·nê- qe·la‘ wə·šā·ṯū hā·mū kə·mōw- yā·yin ū·mā·lə·’ū kam·miz·rāq kə·zā·wî·yō·wṯ miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts will shield them They will destroy and conquer with slingstones . . . they will drink and roar as with wine And they will be filled like sprinkling bowls drenched like the corners of the altar
verses.literalPt: Jeová dos Exércitos os defenderá; eles devorarão e pisarão aos pés as fundas; beberão e farão alvoroço como de vinho; e ficarão cheios como as bacias de sacrifício, como os cantos do altar.

verses.original: וְֽהוֹשִׁיעָ֞ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּצֹ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ כִּ֚י אַבְנֵי־ נֵ֔זֶר מִֽתְנוֹסְס֖וֹת עַל־ אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·wō·šî·‘ām Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem bay·yō·wm ha·hū kə·ṣōn ‘am·mōw kî ’aḇ·nê- nê·zer miṯ·nō·ws·sō·wṯ ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: On that day the LORD their God will save them as the flock of His people for like jewels in a crown they will sparkle over His land
verses.literalPt: Jeová, seu Deus, os salvará, naquele dia, como o rebanho do seu povo; porque eles serão como as pedras de uma coroa, elevadas sobre a terra dele.

verses.original: כִּ֥י מַה־ טּוּב֖וֹ וּמַה־ יָפְי֑וֹ דָּגָן֙ בַּֽחוּרִ֔ים וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ יְנוֹבֵ֥ב בְּתֻלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kî mah- ṭū·ḇōw ū·mah- yā·p̄ə·yōw dā·ḡān ba·ḥū·rîm wə·ṯî·rō·wōš yə·nō·w·ḇêḇ bə·ṯu·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: How lovely they will be and how beautiful Grain will make the young men flourish and new wine the young women
verses.literalPt: Pois quão grande é a sua bondade, e quão grande é a sua formosura! O trigo fará florescer os mancebos, e o mosto, as donzelas.
